title: Artificial Authority: From Machine Minds to Political Alignments. An Experimental Analysis of Democratic and Autocratic Biases in Large-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering validated psychometric and political orientation scales (Right-Wing Authoritarianism, Social Dominance Orientation, World Values Survey, and Pew Research surveys) to LLMs, and analyzing both their numerical ratings and textual justifications to evaluate their alignment with democratic versus autocratic values.

Comparing the measured political and democratic value orientations of various LLMs to the public opinion survey data of their respective countries of origin (US, France, UAE, Poland, China, Russia) to see if models reflect local, culturally specific understandings of governance.
